subject.title: Skill Workshop approval succeeds in Control UI but independent operator list/replay stays empty

question: Should a pending plugin approval be discoverable by every paired client with `operator.approvals`, or only by clients satisfying the approval's reviewer/device binding?
rationale: The issue's independent-client expectation and current main's documented reviewer-binding contract imply different authorization scopes; changing that scope could expose approval details or resolution authority.

options.title: Preserve reviewer binding
options.body: Keep approval visibility bound to authorized reviewers, but make durable replay reliable and return clear routing metadata to the initiating surface.

options.title: Allow all approval operators
options.body: Permit every paired `operator.approvals` client to list and resolve pending plugin approvals, with explicit documentation and authorization tests.

recommendation.title: Preserve reviewer binding
recommendation.body: Keep approval visibility bound to authorized reviewers, but make durable replay reliable and return clear routing metadata to the initiating surface.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this person to the original approval surface and later session/device-scoping work.
